full_judgment: 4. Trial Court decreed the suit, but the lower appellate Court dismissed the suit. Plaintiffs then moved the High Court Division in revision and obtained the Rule which was ultimately made absolute restoring the judgment and decree of the trial Court. Hence this Leave Petition by the purchasers-defendant Nos. 3 to 8.
